Complete family of Decipher oversized and magazine-insert premiums, with the 5×7 [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] held next to the regular-size original. Still at 5:28 of ''Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards''.

Fair use of a video still for identification of the physical premiums on [[Oversized cards]]. Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frvqLMqMc14 The CCG Collector] (29 November 2015). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-frvqLMqMc14 Internet Archive].
